agricultural-origins-exchange.alt: Two boxes joined by arrows across the Atlantic, titled the Columbian Exchange, after 1492. From the Americas to Europe, Africa and Asia: maize (corn), potatoes, tomatoes, cacao, cassava and chili peppers. From Afro-Eurasia to the Americas: wheat and rice, sugarcane, coffee, cattle, pigs, horses and chickens, and diseases such as smallpox and measles. Plants, animals and diseases crossed the ocean in both directions.
